objective: Produce combined economics, durable outcome, and exact acquisition-cost-per-outcome performance for only fully mature relationships inside a created-at cohort and one fixed N-day observation window.

composition.cohort: exactly one canonical CRM listCreatedAtRange read
composition.rawEvidence: exactly one INS-004L getEvidence call for the full created-at cohort
composition.conversionWindow: exactly one INS-004O/INS-004P conversion-window evidence pass
composition.attributedEconomics: one in-memory canonical attributed economics build for mature relationships only
composition.performanceProjection: reuse canonical INS-004J combined economics/outcome/cost projection

rules: Requested dimensions are validated and deduplicated before persistence access.
The CRM created-at cohort is resolved exactly once.
The raw evidence application is called exactly once with the full created-at cohort.
Relationship identity and createdAt are retained together until conversion-window maturity is evaluated.
Only mature relationships enter the N-day denominator.
Immature relationships are reported separately and do not enter economics, outcome, or cost-per-outcome projections.
Evidence before relationship creation is excluded.
Evidence exactly at relationship creation is eligible.
Evidence exactly at the N-day window end is excluded.
The same conversion-window-filtered economics and durable outcome facts feed all three projection families.
Current presentation metadata is filtered to mature relationship identity but is not historically reconstructed.

No second raw evidence load, second durable outcome read, second conversion-window pass, new SQL, schema change, persistence mutation, rate division, currency conversion, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation is introduced.
